migrations.summary: The v1 application component contract is additive; existing adapter-only consumers remain valid.
Semantic pictograms, UI control glyphs and component icon slots are additive; migrate direct provider imports through the governed adapter when adopting the release.
The application atmosphere grammar is additive; pages without data-ledger-section are untouched, and consumer-local background recipes migrate to manifest carriers at leisure.
The motion grammar is additive; existing pages keep their shipped motion, beacons breathe only where a composition opts in, and the flow recipe requires no animation library.
Card roles and workflow step states are additive; existing cards keep their anatomy, and deriveStates replaces hand-written boolean gating.

The spec grid is a new, additive component; nothing existing changes. Consumers that hand-rolled a hairline matrix should move to specGridFor, because the short last row and the container-driven collapse are what the emitter exists to handle.

The brand identity contract is additive. Surfaces rendering the wordmark through plus a brightness(0) invert(1) filter should move to the inline asset, which inherits currentColor and therefore follows the register.
The Miro collaboration profile is additive and affects no existing surface. Workshop boards built as a flattened canvas image should be rebuilt from native objects.
